steps.name: Public request end-to-end through serve and deploy
steps.description: Close the production loop: a real `overdrive serve` composition with `NodeAdapters::host` and `GatewayAdapters::host`, a deployed VM Service and a deployed Route, and a public TLS 1.3 HTTP/1.1 request that is accepted by the production listener, selected by the registered-socket hook, dialed to leg-C with exact-peer mTLS and relayed over kTLS legs and spliced bodies to the workload (ADR-0220).
criteria: Activates key `public-request-end-to-end` (S-PIG-01, 56 N, 60 N, 69, 70, 71 N, 105, 109, 113, 115 N): the eleven `native_metal_kvm_public_ingress_gateway_*` tests in tests/conformance/tests/public_ingress_gateway_end_to_end.rs and the connector arm at crates/overdrive-gateway/src/connector.rs:724 go RED then GREEN on native metal
An external TLS 1.3 client receives a streamed 200 from the VM Service over kernel TLS legs, with the ULP, tls_stat deltas and the relay probe occurrence observed
No stale Service entry yields a wrong-peer success; the guest flow ending mid-request is a 502 with no intent or receipt left; stalled head and stalled body each answer 408
After a serve restart the gateway answers 503 until the hydrator reprograms, then the backend response

128 concurrent exchanges stay within the descriptor and memory budget; exact-length and chunked bodies relay octet-exact over keep-alive; no KeyUpdate is sent across a 16 MiB response; the client reads the response before a clean close

Production call sites exercised with no test-only wiring: run_server (enabled gateway arm), GatewayAdapters::host/HostGatewayRelay, the gateway selection cgroup/connect4 hook registration in EbpfDataplane::open_upstream, ServiceMapHydrator programming, the leg-C accept path to GuestStreamDial, and `deploy_resource` for the Route; no test installs a rule, binds a socket, programs a map or supplies an address production does not
